definitions.explanation: Japan's largest stock exchange, in Nihonbashi, Tokyo. The short name is what news reports and market talk normally use.

examples.japanese: {東証|とうしょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{株価|かぶか}→株価：05154_kabuka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がった→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。
examples.english: Share prices on the Tokyo Stock Exchange rose.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{来年|らいねん}→来年：00745_rainen⟧{東証|とうしょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{上場|じょうじょう}→上場：11189_joujou_b⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧だ。
examples.english: This company plans to list on the Tokyo Stock Exchange next year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{円安|えんやす}→円安：04854_enyasu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けて→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧、⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{東証|とうしょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{輸出|ゆしゅつ}→輸出：02094_yushutsu⟧⟦{関連|かんれん}→関連：00177_kanren⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{株|かぶ}→株：02592_kabu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{買|か}われた→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: With the weaker yen, export-related stocks were bought on the Tokyo Stock Exchange today.

notes:
FORMS:
Short for {東京証券取引所|とうきょうしょうけんとりひきじょ}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {東証|とうしょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{上場|じょうじょう}→上場：11189_joujou_b⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be listed on the TSE
- {東証|とうしょう}プライム: the TSE Prime Market, its top segment (since 2022)
- {東証|とうしょう}{株価|かぶか}{指数|しすう}: the Tokyo Stock Price Index (TOPIX)
- {東証|とうしょう}⟦{一部|いちぶ}→一部：06783_ichibu⟧: the former First Section, abolished in 2022 but still heard

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{日経平均|にっけいへいきん}→日経平均：31835_nikkeiheikin⟧: the Nikkei Stock Average, the other index quoted in every market report; it is published by a newspaper, not by the exchange
